title: Stored crystal melt carried from Central Nexus to the Hex Star bid (Dheneb, lawless) and sold there
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-24 15:33 UTC (MISSION: surplus liquidated; orders ENT-090 P1 pay for itself; rules F24, F23). Hex Star (Dheneb, a [HEXC] station, a neutral partner) bid 3,508 cr x 142 for crystal melt (table books, read 15:27:50 UTC); every home bid is 54. Our traders store 344 melt at Central Nexus (holdings 15:30 UTC), none of it reserved (stock surplus: 816 surplus, reserved 0). A pilot whose own storage at Central Nexus holds 20 or more withdraws what its hold and the bid take at the best price (route_run.withdraw_units) and sells at 3,000 or more; what is not sold is stored at Hex Star, where sell-melt-at-dheneb sells it later. Road: 11 jumps, 6 lawless, the road of sell-ember-first-step-dheneb and sell-loot-at-dheneb (paying, runs of 2026-11-24). The bid is a player's order and does not regain: requires.bid closes the route once it is gone; max_ships 2 because two loads of our stored melt fill it.
